subject: gk
question:
Identify the correct statements about Independence Day and Republic Day of India.

i) Independence Day is celebrated on 15th August since 1947.

ii) Republic Day is celebrated on 26th January since 1950.

iii) Independence Day is celebrated as Independence from British rule.

iv) Republic day is celebrated since the Constituent Assembly of India adopted the Constitution of India in 1949.
solution:
The correct answer is__** i,ii and iii**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• i**) Independence Day is celebrated on 15th August since 1947.**

 
 
• **This statement is True**
 
• Independence Day marks the day India gained independence from **British rule on 15th August 1947.**
 
• The British ended their colonial rule, and India became an independent nation on that day.
 
• The **first Independence Day was celebrated in 1947, **and since then, it has been celebrated annually on the same date.
 
 
 
• ii) **Republic Day is celebrated on 26th January since 1950**.
 
 
• **This statement is Tru**e
 
• Republic Day is celebrated to honor the date when the **Constitution of India came into effect on 26th January 1950,** making India a Republic.
 
• The day marks the transition from a British Dominion to a fully sovereign nation, where the Indian Constitution became the supreme law of the land.
 
• Even though the **Constitution was adopted on 26th November 1949, it was only enforced on 26th January 1950**, which is why Republic Day is celebrated on this date.
 
 
 
• iii) **Independence Day is celebrated as Independence from British rule**.
 
 
• **This statement is True**
 
• Independence Day is a celebration of India's freedom from British colonial rule.
 
• After **nearly 200 years of British contro**l, India gained its independence on 15th August 1947.
 
• It marks the **end of British rule and the beginning of self-governance.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• i**v) Republic Day is celebrated since the Constituent Assembly of India adopted the Constitution of India in 1949**.

 
 
• This statement is not true
 
• The Constituent Assembly did adopt the Constitution on 26th November 1949,** but Republic Day is celebrated on 26th January, the day in 1950** when the Constitution was implemented and India officially became a Republic.
 
• While the Constitution was adopted in 1949, it only came into effect on 26th January 1950, and that's why Republic Day is celebrated on that date.
